laws.rule: Kiambu County Alcoholic Drinks Control Act 2024, Act 6: Commenced 10 December 2024. Sections 46 and 52: no selling, supplying or providing alcohol to under-18s; no under-18 access to the licensed area where alcohol is made, stored, sold or consumed, and no adult entering that area accompanied by an under-18. Section 46 recognises a valid passport as an age-check document.

Kiambu County Alcoholic Drinks Control Act 2024, Act 6: Section 53 covers being drunk and disorderly in or near a street, road, licensed premises, shop, hotel or other public place. Section 55(2)(b) also prohibits buying or consuming at an outlet after its licensed hours. These are county provisions, not a claim that all ordinary adult public drinking is banned.

Kiambu County Alcoholic Drinks Control Act 2024, Act 6: Third Schedule: general retail on-licence Monday-Friday 17:00-23:00, weekends/public holidays 14:00-23:00; wines/spirits off-licence in towns/urban areas 17:00-23:00 daily; supermarket off-licence 10:00-21:00 daily. Separately licensed bar-and-restaurant and nightclub categories have different, later hours. A hotel’s any-hour exception is for a lodger and their guest on the premises, not every walk-in. Check the actual licence/category; these are not uniform hours for every venue.
